tools.name: search_projects
tools.description: Find off-plan and ready projects in the Palmera catalog by country, area, developer, bedrooms, price and completion status. Returns a compact list with a canonical URL for each result; call get_project for the full content of one.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Full published content for one project: description, unit types, payment plan, amenities, FAQs, images and the canonical page URL. Pass `lang` to get one language instead of all of them.

tools.name: list_developers
tools.description: Developers with published projects, and how many each has. Use the slug to filter search_projects.

tools.name: list_areas
tools.description: Areas with published projects, and how many each has. Use the slug to filter search_projects.
